parsed.explanation: Local regime is strongly protective: public-accommodation and employment anti-discrimination retained 67.8% in a popular vote, gender-identity hate-crime reporting, self-declared state documents, and a healthcare shield law, with no local birth-sex facility ban. The unenforced sodomy provisions, unenforceable since 1974, are tangential. However the shared national regime remains traveller-facing and hostile: passport sex restricted to birth sex, entry officers instructed to refuse on document/sex discrepancy and consider lifetime fraud ineligibility, federal facility restrictions, documented birth-sex custody and immigration-custody abuse, and official threat-framing, with courts only partly blocking measures. Local protections move the rating up from the parent average but cannot neutralise border and federal custody exposure, placing it below independent low-risk jurisdictions and above unremedied universal exclusion.
